Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: People budget gate: QBR checklist and role gating

Team —

As we head into the October QBR and the OKR checkpoint, I ran the people gate worksheet (attached) and want decisions on the items below by EOD Thursday so we can lock hiring plans for the next quarter. TL;DR: we need to greenlight 3 backfills, pause 4 lower-priority reqs, and decide on one new headcount request tied to an OKR stretch.

Key asks (please reply inline):
- REQ-7843 (Infra SRE, senior backfill): request approval to post and proceed with offers. Impact: restores availability for nightly backups and reduces on-call carry by 20% (Q4 OKR).
- REQ-8021 (Product Manager — new role): request funding but only if we re-prioritize two feature PM reqs. We need explicit tradeoff decision.
- REQ-7999 / REQ-8011 / REQ-8055 (L2/L3 IC roles): propose pause until Q1 or convert to 6-month contractor; see tab B in worksheet for cost delta.

Notes: headcount delta required to meet committed Q4 throughput (model in the attached CSV). If we delay the infra backfill we take a measurable hit to platform uptime targets. If we proceed with the PM hire without de-scoping feature work, we'll exceed our hiring budget by ~1.2 FTE-equivalent.

Attachments: People-Gate-Worksheet.xlsx (decision matrix), headcount-impact-model.csv (cost/OKR simulation).

Proposed cadence: you each mark Approve / Defer / Pause on the worksheet and add one sentence rationale. I will compile and circulate final decisions for payroll and recruiting.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: People budget gate: QBR checklist and role gating

Monica —

Thanks for the clear matrix. Quick responses inline:

- REQ-7843 Infra SRE backfill: Approve. This is critical to meeting Q4 uptime OKR; please prioritize offers and coordinate with Recruiting to expedite references.
- REQ-8021 Product Manager (new): Defer for now. Need a one-page RACI that shows which current PMs would give up scope (or what features would be de-scoped). Without that I can't justify new headcount this quarter.
- REQ-7999 / REQ-8011 / REQ-8055 L2/L3: Pause non-critical L3 IC hires. We should convert one to a contractor for Q4 if possible.

Also: can we get an estimate from Finance on the budget reforecast impact if we convert two open reqs to contractors? If conversion keeps us within the committed FTE budget, I'm more comfortable approving one additional role.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

Monica / Laura —

I ran a quick scenario in the headcount-impact-model.csv and added comments on the sheet. High level:

- Pause all non-urgent L3 hires (agree with Laura). Those hires collectively free up ~0.7 FTE-equivalent in cashflow this quarter.
- Approve REQ-7843 (Infra SRE) as a priority backfill. We cannot carry the current on-call overhead into Q4 without additional risk to latency SLAs.
- REQ-8021 (PM): if we must do this now, swap it against REQ-8055 (mid-level PM IC) and delay REQ-7999. That keeps net FTE impact neutral but requires product to reprioritize features A and C.

Proposal for redeployment: if we convert one L3 job to a 6-month contractor and reassign two senior ICs to cover feature A for Q4, we keep the PM request viable without expanding budget materially. I'm attaching the CSV I used.

Markus
